description: Returns every status page with its slug, title, published state and custom domains. The list dates from login, so a page that another client or the web UI created or deleted since may be missing or still listed; changes made through this server show at once, and getStatusPage always reads fresh.
name: listStatusPages

customCSS.description: Custom CSS for the status page

description.description: Description shown on the status page

domainNameList.description: Custom domain names for this status page

published.description: Whether the status page is publicly accessible

showPoweredBy.description: Whether to show Uptime Kuma branding

showTags.description: Whether to show tags on the status page

slug.description: URL slug for the status page

title: List Status Pages
